preprocessing.channel: Only admitted original mono. EN03 stereo is unavailable: never auto-selected, mixed, summed, averaged or chosen by energy.

preprocessing.conversion: Selected bundled FFmpeg receipt 27350ff2f953bbd4d6ca8bfe0f6808b99b9752192657d289146b50319099f66a; raw s16le mono44100 input, aresample=16000:resampler=swr:filter_size=32:phase_shift=10:linear_interp=1:exact_rational=1, mono float32 output. Once only; exact output count/hash required, no trim/pad/channel operation. No preprocessing was executed in this freeze.
preprocessing.processor: Pinned feature extractor do_normalize=true: (x-mean(x))/sqrt(var(x)+1e-7); sampling_rate=16000; padding=False; return_attention_mask=False; no VAD, gain fitting, silence trimming or reference-timed subwindows.

candidate.transcript: Use blind-provider-inputs ordered original row occurrences. Known ordinary rows, including explicit partial edge rows, normalize only through existing normalizeWord then uppercase. Preserve original strings separately; only A-Z/apostrophe are representable. Tagged/unknown/unsupported rows are not rewritten, expanded or passed as guessed words; their row IDs remain explicit unknown/missing. No source ph tier, phone times or word timestamps enter the aligner.
candidate.alignment: Model eval forward over the full30s prepared waveform; log_softmax(logits, dim=-1) yields finite [1,T,32]. Build exact character targets with vocabulary | delimiter id4 between known original word units; blank id0 is never a target, unknown id3 is forbidden. CPU torchaudio.functional.forced_align(blank=0) then merge_tokens; require exact target token order/count, preserve raw path/scores/token spans, exclude delimiter spans from word endpoint grouping. Group only each supplied row occurrence’s complete character spans; no threshold, star/wildcard substitution, ASR rewrite or reference timing offset.

timeMapping.rule: Native merged-token spans are [startFrame,endFrameExclusive). Retain integers and N/T source-to-emission ratio; output local seconds = frame*N/(T*16000), as the pinned upstream proportional-frame recipe, without rounding to ms or fitting an offset. Original selected clock = local seconds + declared window origin.
timeMapping.expectedTAuthority: Derived mechanically from pinned conv_kernel/conv_stride for480000 samples, must also match actual forward shape. No forward was run.
timeMapping.latency: No manually fitted shift or p95 rescue. Record frame quantum/ratio and unknown label precision.

candidate.retention: Save complete prepared audio, model/runtime/source recipe hashes, finite emissions, full native path/scores/token spans and per-row timed/unknown/missing results before gates. Invalid native output remains unverified diagnostic data; never repair nonfinite/out-of-clock values.

scoring.owner: Extend existing packages/test-harness/speech/evaluate.mjs under write-tests red/green; no second percentile or matching owner. This protocol freezes test-first controls, not an implemented/passed scorer.
scoring.unit: One original wd-tier occurrence, not a guessed split/merge of a row or a bag of words. Preserve original IDs/text/order and all neighboring/partial/tagged rows.
scoring.denominator: All fully-contained original wd rows except exact <p:>. Exact <p:> is a non-word silent pause under the original conventions. Every other fully-contained marked, unknown, unrepresentable, missing or source-channel-unknown word remains in timed-word coverage denominator and contributes no fictitious error.
scoring.partialAndNeighbors: Original clipped rows and outside neighbors remain independently reported with partial/unknown support. They do not enter the fully-contained word-pair denominator fixed by source-selection; never clamp their reference endpoints to clip edges or pretend a full word was scored. Their missing endpoints remain unknown.
scoring.matching: Preserve supplied stable original row occurrence IDs and normalized text, ordered and unique. Require matching source/PCM/recipe identity and admitted mono channel. A repeated word can match at most its own supplied occurrence; duplicate/foreign IDs or a lexical mismatch cannot fill an omitted occurrence. Never choose a match by better reference endpoint proximity.
scoring.validCandidate: A matched pair must have both finite ordered positive-length bounds inside the declared30s clock, exact raw-token/frame provenance and correct occurrence/text. Missing either endpoint leaves the word untimed. Invalid evidence refuses scoring rather than clamping or replacing null/NaN/Inf with zero.
scoring.coverage: timed matched full-word pairs / all full non-pause word rows. Zero denominator is undefined/pending, never100%. Report numerator/denominator and every untimed ID/reason, independently per case, development, confirmation and full cohort.
scoring.endpointErrors: Both absolute start and end error per admitted timed word against original human-corrected wd times on the exact original/window clock. Missing/unknown endpoint errors remain null and are counted separately, never0. Retain all known errors, nearest-rank p95 = sorted[ceil(.95*n)-1] from existing percentile owner, median, maximum, signed errors and threshold outliers.

gates.coldStartup: Import/model-load time reported separately, never relabeled as warm inference. Inference phase includes processor+forward+forced_align+span/output production, not a model-only sub-timer. No cost was measured.
gates.promotion: Full original six-case coverage/endpoint/cost/provenance admission required. Development and untouched confirmation reported separately; a narrow mono result cannot promote the family.
